outline.name: Bardon Mill Station Signal Box
outline.description: Railway signal box, built around 1874, by and for the North Eastern Railway Company for the Newcastle and Carlisle Railway. Type N1 design of the 1870s-1890s.

field_evidence: Official Planning Data listed-building-outline entity 42153074 is authoritative, names Bardon Mill Station Signal Box, supplies a MultiPolygon, and identifies listed-building 1468393; its official notes describe a railway signal box built around 1874 for the North Eastern Railway Company. Historic England list entry 1468393 names Bardon Mill Station Signal Box and identifies it as Grade II.
